name: Lluwen
description: Lluwen is a hoofed elf hunter from Lorwyn who turned against Morcant, followed the students to Arcavios, and became a Witherbloom student at Strixhaven.

summary.text: Lluwen is a hoofed elf hunter from Lorwyn who turned against Morcant, followed the students to Arcavios, and became a Witherbloom student at Strixhaven.

bio.text: Serving High Perfect Morcant, Lluwen captured the student Kirol in the Gilt-Leaf Wood and brought them to Lys Alana.

bio.text: Horrified by Morcant's plans to kill the night with dawnglow, he refused to let Kirol die, abandoned Morcant, and later headbutted her and stole her vial.

timeline.summary: Lluwen holds a knife to Kirol and demands to know what they know about why Isilu walks.
timeline.quote: I know you know why Isilu walks. I want to know what you know.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.quote: High Perfect Morcant will want to see you.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.quote: Come along. I'm taking you to High Perfect Morcant now.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.quote: I've found a stranger in the forest who knows something of Isilu and why he walks out of sync with his promised time.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.quote: With the weapons of the night, of course.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.quote: You're going to go inside and gather them for us.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.quote: They don't deserve to die that way.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Lluwen decides to follow Kirol and Ajani, abandoning Morcant.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Lluwen headbutts Morcant, steals her vial and throws it to Sanar.
timeline.quote: He leaned over to pluck the vial from her hand.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.quote: We're going to see the queen,

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Eirdu's belling cry halts the battle as Eirdu arrives and Oko drops from the air.
timeline.quote: A golden glow appeared on the horizon, growing brighter and brighter before rising like the sun, and Eirdu appeared.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.quote: We can do both,

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.quote: But I helped one of the students, and if I stay here, they will kill me.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani leads the group through an Omenpath to Shandalar and on to Arcavios, bringing Lluwen.
timeline.quote: Together, they walked into the cascading light, and another world was left behind.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Lluwen writes about feeling isolated among Arcavian elves and plans to join the Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave.
timeline.quote: There's a Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave in the works right now.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.quote: Lluwen, if it would help you to have company, I don't mind coming along at all.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel quizzes his students on what they hear; Lluwen, stung by yesterday's rebuke, wants to give a right answer.
timeline.quote: I want to give the right answer

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Ivarin taunts Lluwen as a goat and ram-clan, and Lluwen retaliates by slashing his chest with a knife.
timeline.quote: He dragged the knife across Ivarin's chest.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel pins Lluwen's coat to a tree with a thorn and orders him to control himself or find another home.
timeline.quote: You will learn to control yourself, or you will learn to find another home,

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen realizes the titan's bones are hollow and falls through into the dark.
timeline.quote: Lluwen fell into the dark.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen wakes in the titan's hollow to find six archaics gathered around a snarl of magic and chanting.
timeline.quote: six enormous figures, each with too many limbs undulating in time, sat gathered around a thick snarl of magic—archaics.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.quote: Lluwen didn't need to be told twice.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.quote: I hope you have something to impress me.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.quote: she told me that all archaics used to be oracles.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.quote: No, I swore an oath of devotion, Jadzi.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.quote: No. He couldn't tell Fel.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.quote: You aren't a coward.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel asks Tam and Lluwen if they have seen Oracle Jadzi, who is missing.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen tells Tam they are in Titan's Grave, deeper than any records go.
timeline.quote: "In Titan's Grave. Deeper than we have any records of going, if we can trust the Shattered."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen volunteers to scout a path out, and Suki insists he take someone with him; Kirol claims the job.
timeline.quote: "It's best if you have someone with you.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.quote: "Does anyone else smell burning?"

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2026.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2026.
